profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary:
A technical professional with experience developing large software projects, including:
     Developed web automation by using Robot Framework(Selenium).
     Developed, maintained interfaces bringing vendors' data to central data store by using Hadoop, HIVE and Sqoop. 
    Designed, developed custom reports by using Eclipse BIRT report.
    Designed, developed and maintained Terminal emulating user interface by using Oracle Forms 3.
    Designed, developed and maintained Reporting system by using TCL Scripting Language.
    Designed, developed and tested scanning system by using Struts 2 framework, Spring 2.x framework, Hibernate 3.x framework, Oracle Database.
     Using Solaris cron job to schedule Java process exporting data out from Oracle to MS SQL Server.
     Using JasperReport to create packing slip, commercial invoice.

Specialties: Java, Python, Ruby, PL/SQL, Groovy, TCL, JavaScript, XML, CSS, HTML, Eclipse, Oracle Forms,OSX, Unix (Solaris), Linux, Windows, Struts2, Spring, JPA, Hibernate, Oracle, MySql, MongoDB, MS SQL Server, GlassFish, Apache, Nginx, Tocmat, JasperReport

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained business to client and business to business rest apis - Java, spring boot, GAE, cloud datastore.
Utilized Google cloud platform services to provide architecture solutions in retail technology transformation project - cloud run, cloud endpoints, pub/sub, app engine, cloud functions, dataflow, memorystore

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed internal api endpoints by using Java, JUnit, Spring Boot, Tomcat.
Developed third party logistic data integration by using Javascript, Node.js.
Developed web applications by using Ruby on Rails.
Developed and maintained order entry system by using Struts 2, Spring, Hibernate.
Developed web automation by using Robot Framework(Selenium), and Python.
Developed ETL process by using AWS EMR, AWS RDS PostgreSQL, Apache Sqoop and Ruby.
Developed data migration process to move data from Mysql to MongoDB .

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Web application development - Ruby, Rails, Docker, MySql, Bootstrap 4, JQuery, Google pub/sub

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work closely with clients to deliver sensible solutions that leverage technology to meet business goals for the organization. Develop applications and resolve complex problems.

Achievement:
 Designed and developed interfaces on Hadoop Framework to bring bulk load capability to user when business requires months of data in one shot.
 Selected to lead project to build and hold web services to collect data from ISO organizations that included FMM market price tool and BPA forecast and 30mp data.
 Designed and maintained BIRT report for complex business logic that included Fuel Requirement, RUC Awards, WhiteBoard and NetPosition reports.
 Applied CDH4.3 patch to all Hadoop Clusters to resolve memory leak issue introduced in CDH4.3 to avoid cluster crashes that causes business disruption.
 Upgraded Redwood Chronacle Master nodes to newer version to resolve an “unknown” job status and created step by step documentation for future reference.
 Administered Redwood Chronacle scheduling system, including scheduling jobs, creating new job chains, creating new job definition, system troubleshooting.
 Mentored junior developers by giving domain knowledge transfer, defining proper problem domain, and providing suggestion on code review session.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Works closely with clients to deliver sensible solutions that leverage technology to meet business goals for the organization.  This role requires someone with knowledge of ERP applications from a code level with the ability to understand and decode complex problems.
Responsibilities: 
Analyzing and resolving technical issues 
Giving feedback to customers on a regular basis
Escalation of bugs
Coding modules for customers
Customer Support of our applications
Coordinate with team members to ensure accuracy between order entry, accounting, purchasing, and inventory control modules
Achievement:
Using Struts 2, Spring 2 and JPA to create warehouse inventory scanner system.
Using JasperReport to create Canadian Commercial Invoice.
Using SqlServer 2008 Reporting service to create Accounts Payable Reports.
Participated in team to migrate COBOL legacy system to Oracle platform.
Designed and developed Physical Inventory Count Sub System using TCL and SQL.
Modified and Re-designed Commission calculation process using TCL and SQL.
Designed and developed bridge processes pushing data from Oracle to SQL Server using Java, JDBC and SQL.
Mentored junior developers by giving domain knowledge transfer, defining proper problem domain, and providing suggestion on code review session.
